## How it was checked

- [ ] After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm verify` passes (offline checks; no API key or external services)
- [ ] If questions or thresholds changed: live `pnpm eval` before/after numbers are in this PR (API key and network required; may incur API charges)
- [ ] If a command was added or renamed: `pnpm build:skill` was run
